description: FREE. The public facts of an IPO: company, ticker, CIK, exchange, listing date, shares offered, price range, final offer price when the deal has priced, and gross proceeds. Use it to identify a deal before buying the full profile with get_ipo_snapshot. Provide exactly one of companyId, symbol, or cik.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042 or 0001876042.

companyId.description: IPOSignal company id (24-character hex), as returned by other IPOSignal responses.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_ipo_overview

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key: the registrant's permanent SEC identifier, as a 10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0001876042.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

date.description: First trading day, YYYY-MM-DD. For a deal that has not listed, the scheduled date.

exchange.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

offerPrice.description: Final offer price, USD per share. Null until the deal has priced.

offerSize.description: Gross proceeds, USD: shares offered × offer price.

priceRange.description: The filed price range as text, low to high, USD per share, e.g. $16.00-$18.00. Null once the final price is known.

shares.description: Shares offered in the deal. Not shares outstanding.

ipoDetails.description: Public deal facts. No valuation: marketCap and its source are in get_ipo_snapshot.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

currentHolderCik.description: CIK of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

currentHolderName.description: Name of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

servedCik.description: CIK of the company whose record this response holds.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the ticker you asked for has belonged to more than one company and the record served is not the current holder's. Absent on an ordinary lookup.

venue.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

title: IPO overview (free)
